name: Business pays recurring unexplained amounts to regional intermediaries
description: Operators in conflict-affected areas make periodic payments to individuals labelled as security, fees or consultants.
fp: Private security and facilitation fees can be lawful but need documentation.

sources.text: FATF, Organised Maritime Piracy and Related Kidnapping for Ransom (2011)
UN Security Council Resolution 2133 (2014) on kidnapping for ransom by terrorist groups
